SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the great tree, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Around her, as her world makes them: a leather-bound book with gilt edges; lantern-orbs of soft magical light floating overhead; a pewter cup; an ornate iron key on a silk cord.
Season: winter — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; lamps lit inside, the window dark with night.
Outfit: a lined bodysuit overlaid with a geometric harness of narrow straps — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, terracotta, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.

SUPPORT: she lies on her left side, her left hip and left shoulder on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.

LEFT HAND: her own left elbow rests on the ground, that hand propping up her head.
LEGS: legs bent together to one side.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.
